{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to only converted customers
converted_customers = sales[sales['converted'] == 1]

# Check how many have valid age (not -1)
valid_age_count = (converted_customers['customer_age'] != -1).sum()
print(f'Number of converted customers with valid age: {valid_age_count}')

# Compute mean age, excluding -1
mean_age = converted_customers[converted_customers['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age'].mean()
print(f'Mean age of converted customers (excluding -1): {mean_age}')"}
